title: Emberveil 0.13.0 — Illustrated Frostmere

manifest.notes: Illustrated Frostmere study: Base, High and Extreme; compare at actual 1920 x 1080 / Forward+. Staffs equip in either hand with empty, spell or ward off hand; fitted skinned bracers and continuous lateral sword cuts. Version 13 preserves staff side and existing journeys with backups. Adventure art remains unchanged pending the comparison.

release_notes:
# 0.13.0 — Illustrated Frostmere and fitted equipment

- New isolated illustrated-fantasy study with Base, High and Extreme, plus a fixed comparison route and real-resolution reports.
- Painted surfaces, smooth stylized traveler, layered trees, moving meadow, patterned stone/wood, warm lodge and fine decoration. Quality tiers increase detail and sampling.
- Staffs work in either hand; the free hand can be relaxed, hold a spell or maintain a ward. Physical hand inputs, inventory slots, Grimoire labels and saved loadouts agree.
- Skinned bracer shells replace rigid tubes; both bodies use their own fitted armor geometry.
- Shoulder-led lateral sword arcs preserve edge-first contact and continuous recovery. Forward and two-handed cuts retain their established behavior.
- Save version 13 retains staff side, migrates older journeys and preserves a versioned backup.
- Corrected benchmark warm-up accounting so even a very slow validation run records a full measured minute.

Publication: standalone candidate. The existing launcher feed remains 0.12.1 pending restored release-upload authentication. No new RTX performance claim is made. See VALIDATION.md and ILLUSTRATED-STUDY.md.
